scenario: The `decay` time model (EWMA forgetting) is not in v1: exponential forgetting weights each sample by exp(-Δt/τ) on a data-dependent Δt, which is within-platform-deterministic only, not cross-platform bit-exact, so v1 has no exact backing for it. `decay` lexes as a bare identifier the observation time-model grammar cannot match. Pin: `max decay 10_min` is a parse error (DS_PARSE_GENERIC); the satisfiable alternatives are `max sliding 10_min` or `max all_time`.
rules_ds:
schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Float mutable

series Sensor.state:
    max decay 10_min
